label: copy phase (after the first copied output)
explanation: Broad copy-phase feature: fires on 82% of copy steps (t > L) and almost never anywhere else. It is silent through the original phase (<0.1%) and at the <DEL> step (0.4%). Activity ramps up over the copy: it is on at about 44% of recall_idx=1 steps, about 90% from recall_idx>=2, and is weaker/less often active at early copy steps of long sequences (large to_go). Magnitude rises as the copy goes on and is largest when the copied tokens are y, 3 or q (top examples peak on y/3 runs near the end of the copy). It does not depend on token identity for whether it fires, and it is not selective for L, digits or repeats. Misses are mostly early copy steps in sequences where it has not ramped up yet. phase==2 gives F1 0.90 with essentially all of the activation mass; recall_idx>=2 has the same F1 with higher precision.

issues: Minor overclaim: 'token identity affects magnitude but not whether it fires' is not quite right. On test with recall_idx>=2, the firing rate depends on the copied token. It ranges from about 0.73 (u), 0.80 (o), 0.81 (n) and 0.83 (d/i/r) up to 0.97-0.98 (g, e, y, q, 3); digits are 0.959. So token identity changes the firing rate somewhat, as well as the magnitude. This is a gradient across tokens, not a separate class of misses.

Ramp claims check out (dev): recall_idx=1 fires 44%, recall_idx>=2 fires about 90%, and to_go>=5 with recall_idx>=2 has precision 0.825 against 0.918 at to_go=0. Original phase <0.1% and <DEL> 0.4% are also confirmed. Misses (2308 test steps) hold 0.0% of the mass and are the <DEL> step or the last original steps of L=9 sequences.

Test scores reproduce: phase==2 gives P 0.82, R 0.999, F1 0.900, mass recall 1.0. Alternatives do no better in any meaningful way: recall_idx>=2 F1 0.902 (mass 0.948), (recall_idx>=2)|(L<=5) F1 0.908, to_go<=6 F1 0.904. The false positives are early copy steps and lower-rate tokens, so no systematic missed class remains.
Magnitude peaking on y/3/q is consistent with the mass shares and the top examples. The feature is not selective for repeats (in_tok==prev_tok rate 0.90) or for the correct flag.
